name: ui-reuse-audit
description: Audit UI reuse, consumer availability, and ownership before frontend implementation.

interface.shortDescription: Audit UI reuse and ownership before implementation.
interface.longDescription: Inspect the current consumer, shared UI sources, adapters, and versioned dependencies before frontend implementation to determine what should be reused, composed, adapted, extended upstream, or kept application-specific.
defaultPrompt: Audit this UI task for reuse and ownership before implementation.
Check which existing design-system or shared UI capabilities this consumer can actually use.
Classify the material UI parts before I write the implementation plan.
